name: Server-Side Credential Storage Required
description: API keys and webhook secrets must never be exposed inside client-side JavaScript or public browser environments.
condition: Client-side React or browser code requesting third-party APIs directly.
workaround: Route all requests through backend Express proxy endpoints (/api/*) where keys are stored in server-side environment variables.

name: Browser CORS Pre-Flight Blocking
description: Direct browser-to-API calls are rejected by CORS pre-flight OPTIONS checks.
condition: Invoking APIs directly from client window.fetch()
workaround: Implement an Express proxy handler on the Node server.

name: Public HTTPS Webhook Endpoint Required
description: Webhook callbacks cannot be delivered to localhost or non-TLS HTTP endpoints.
condition: Registering a local IP or HTTP URL as callback destination.
workaround: Use an HTTPS tunnel (e.g. Cloudflare Tunnel, ngrok) during local development and standard TLS in production.

name: Raw Body Buffering for HMAC Verification
description: Verifying HMAC-SHA256 signatures fails if express.json() parses and mutates whitespace in the payload before computing the hash.
condition: Express middleware pipeline running body-parser before signature verification.
workaround: Mount express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }) specifically on webhook ingestion routes.

name: Solana Base58 Address Format
description: Solana endpoints require base58-encoded 32-byte public keys and reject 0x-prefixed hex addresses.
condition: Supplying an EVM address (e.g. 0x123...) to a Solana API endpoint.
workaround: Validate address format with regular expressions before dispatching network requests.

name: EVM 20-Byte Hex Address Format
description: EVM endpoints require 40-hex-character 0x-prefixed addresses with optional EIP-55 checksumming.
condition: Supplying non-EVM address strings to EVM endpoints.

name: Northstar 10 RPS Rate Limit
description: Northstar Data API throttles callers exceeding 10 requests per second with HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.
condition: Workloads demanding > 10 requests per second burst throughput.
workaround: Implement token-bucket rate limiting on the client or upgrade to Aster Wallet or Orbit Gateway.

name: Strata Settlement 10 RPS Cap
description: Strata settlement verification is capped at 10 requests per second.
condition: Exceeding 10 RPS during high volume payment settlement.
workaround: Batch transaction status checks with exponential retry delay.

name: Nexus Portfolio 15 RPS Limit
description: Nexus Portfolio API throttles at 15 requests per second.
condition: Real-time client portfolio dashboard refresh intervals under 60 seconds.
workaround: Cache portfolio USD valuations in memory or Redis for 60-120 seconds.

name: Aster 25 RPS Throughput
description: Aster Wallet supports up to 25 requests per second with a 5,000 requests/minute burst bucket.
workaround: Utilize webhook push event delivery to minimize polling query frequency.

name: Orbit 50 RPS High Throughput
description: Orbit Gateway supports up to 50 requests per second for event subscriptions.
workaround: Orbit automatically buffers outbound events during traffic spikes.

name: Polygon Re-Org Depth Precaution
description: Polygon PoS occasionally experiences shallow reorganizations up to 64 blocks.
condition: High-value token transfer finality detection on Polygon.
workaround: Wait for 128 block confirmations before marking payment transfers as finalized.

name: Base L2 2-Second Block Cadence
description: Base blocks are minted every 2 seconds; event listeners should process messages asynchronously.
workaround: Queue inbound events in a background worker thread or message bus.

name: 100k Block Query Range Cap
description: Contract event log queries with fromBlock to toBlock exceeding 100,000 blocks are rejected with 413 Payload Too Large.
workaround: Split historical query ranges into 50,000 block windows using a chunking loop.

name: Bearer JWT 1-Hour Expiration
description: Bearer access tokens have a 3600-second TTL and must be refreshed prior to expiration.
condition: Long-running daemon processes using stale tokens.
workaround: Implement proactive token refresh 5 minutes before TTL expiry.

name: Strict OAuth Redirect URI Validation
description: OAuth callbacks are only permitted to exact pre-registered HTTPS redirect URIs.
workaround: Register staging and production URIs in the provider dashboard.

name: Serverless HTTP Connection Reuse
description: High-concurrency AWS Lambda or Google Cloud Functions creating new TCP/TLS handshakes per request will exhaust sockets.
condition: Rapid serverless invocations without keep-alive agent.
workaround: Initialize http.Agent({ keepAlive: true }) outside the serverless handler scope.

name: Explicit Unsupported Network Fallback
description: Applications must display explicit notices when a requested network cannot be served by the primary provider.
workaround: Inspect candidate network support prior to dispatch and present clear fallback guidance.
source: Controlled demo dataset - UI UX Best Practices
